name: Recital Y
title: REPORT on the role of cohesion policy investment in resolving the current housing crisis
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘to the fight against climate change and to the European Green Deal, as well as’ and ‘whereas the construction sector should adopt circular and regenerative models; whereas buildings account for around 40 % of EU energy use and 36 % of CO₂ emissions, making their decarbonisation through large-scale renovation essential; whereas rising housing and energy costs highlight the urgent need for affordable, public or not-for-profit housing and for deep renovation to reduce energy poverty; whereas such investment must support green, climate-friendly solutions and align with EU environmental objectives;’
